trial_court: Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Jawali, District Kangra, H.P. in Criminal Application No. 90-IV/06
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Present petitioner had filed an application under Section 125 Cr.PC for grant of interim maintenance allowance from the respondent-herein, which was allowed by the learned trial Court. Feeling aggrieved with the order dated 11.8.2006, respondent-herein preferred a criminal Revision under Section 397 Cr.PC seeking quashment of the order passed by the learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate.

legal_principles.principle: A person claiming maintenance under Section 125 Cr.PC must establish that they are the legally wedded spouse of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that she is a legally wedded wife of the respondent, which has not been done in this case.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider the evidence brought on record by both parties and come to a conclusion based on that evidence.
legal_principles.held: Learned trial Court after perusing the evidence brought on record by the respective parties, came into conclusion that petitioner is entitled to maintenance allowance in terms of Section 125 Cr.PC.

outcome.final_order: The present petition filed under Section 397 (1) Cr.PC read with Section 401 is directed against the order dated 12.7.2007 rendered by Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Kangra at Dharamshala, H.P.
